attempts.text:
This plan rescues 12 of the 16 people at a total cost of 280. Everyone injured, every child (there are none) and every elderly person is rescued, while four adults are deferred. I checked the alternatives by hand rather than with a solver.

**Assumptions**
- **Evacuation point:** Uttargaya shelter is the only one. Kakani temple isn't designated, so nobody can be dropped there.
- **Usable roads:** The Galchhi–Trishuli, Uttargaya–Gajuri and Uttargaya–Syaphru roads are out. Trips east must therefore go through Bidur (17 minutes each way), and Kakani can only be reached directly from the shelter.
- **Categories:** I counted shopkeepers as adults, people in their late seventies and eighties as elderly, and wounded villagers as injured.

**Decisions**
- **Kakani (3 elderly, 4 adults):** One 96-minute round trip brings back the 3 elderly and 1 adult. A second trip would cost 96 to avoid only 60 in penalties for the other 3 adults, so they are deferred.
- **Trishuli and Bidur:** A 48-minute trip brings back the 3 injured, plus 1 adult picked up at Bidur on the way back.
- **Syaphru and Bidur:** A 56-minute trip brings back the 3 elderly, plus 1 adult picked up at Bidur on the way back.
- **Last Bidur adult:** A separate trip would cost 34 minutes, while deferring costs 20, so this person is deferred.
- **Combined Trishuli and Syaphru loop:** This 60-minute route can't carry all 6 people, so it still needs a second trip to Syaphru. Those two trips cost 116 minutes instead of 104.

<plan>
drive car1 uttargaya-shelter kakani-temple
load car1 elderly 3
load car1 adult 1
defer kakani-temple adult 3
drive car1 kakani-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
unload car1 adult 1
drive car2 uttargaya-shelter bidur-temple
drive car2 bidur-temple trishuli-village
load car2 injured 3
drive car2 trishuli-village bidur-temple
load car2 adult 1
drive car2 bidur-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car2 injured 3
unload car2 adult 1
drive car2 uttargaya-shelter bidur-temple
drive car2 bidur-temple syaphru-farm
load car2 elderly 3
drive car2 syaphru-farm bidur-temple
load car2 adult 1
drive car2 bidur-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car2 elderly 3
unload car2 adult 1
defer bidur-temple adult 1
</plan>

**Cost breakdown**

| Item | Calculation | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| car1 to Kakani and back | 48 + 48 | 96 |
| car2 to Trishuli and back | 17 + 7 + 7 + 17 | 48 |
| car2 to Syaphru and back | 17 + 11 + 11 + 17 | 56 |
| Deferred adults | 4 × 20 | 80 |
| **Total** | | **280** |

COST: 280
